name: Cloak Probe (research)
description: Research for an invisibility ability. Ctrl+F12 once: puts a live Stalker's material on your armour (a Terminid mission with a Stalker alive). Again: hides your Helldiver and gear. A third time, or Shift+F12: back to normal. F12 logs the units around you and the Stalker's materials. Needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Solo. Turn off when done.
